main_measure.name: mean next-day unusual short-side move, top third of cases by |forecast|

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day taken together

main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 confirms (with top minus bottom > 0), t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: top third minus bottom third mean unusual short-side move

decided_by: The top-third mean unusual short-side move has t >= 2 and the top-minus-bottom difference is above 0.
reading: Situation bars are computed from prices (up close after at least 2 consecutive down closes, and 60-bar percent price change below -10) on active bars where both can be computed inside the window; the top and bottom thirds are the first and last round(n/3) cases sorted by |forecast| (stable order by coin, window, bar); the day-clustered t sums deviations per UTC day; fewer than 30 top-third cases or days is reported as not observable.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.01361 on the check folds against +0.01694 on every fold
